settings.content: Pieces with the product tag below are sold as pre-orders: the button says Pre-order, the ship-by date shows on the product page and in the bag, and every order line records the ship-by date. While pre-orders are on, any “out now” line in the announcement bar, ticker or cover is swapped for the pre-order line.

settings.label: Last day to pre-order (YYYY-MM-DD)
settings.info: The day after this, the Pre-order button turns off by itself. Leave empty to keep pre-orders open.
